methods.what: Ordering of branch points and diagram of period paths for the theta function, with values of $u_1,u_2$ at the branch points
Difference of logarithms of theta functions expressed via sums of characteristic-like quantities $\alpha,\beta$
Partial derivatives (polar conics) of a cubic curve in $\mathfrak{z},\mathfrak{z}'$ set to zero
Expansion of the cube of a binary quartic, collecting coefficients
